content: We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR or IR to infer carbonyls. Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR ~1700 cm-1, also carbonyl carbon shift ~190-220 ppm in 13C NMR. We could get IR spectra to see carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool. That costs but okay. Then count peaks around 1700 cm-1. The IR output likely includes peaks list. We'll request IR.
